scenes.title: الاسم
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: a lean Arab man in his early thirties with a black beard, deep tired eyes and a sand scarf raises both hands in refusal while a crowd of strangers reaches toward him, some touching his coat, others holding out radios and papers for him to sign, golden dawn light behind them, tents of a vast camp in the distance

scenes.title: الراجل اللي طلع في الشرق
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still at dawn: a single tall figure in a long pale robe standing motionless at the eastern edge of a huge tent camp, seen from far away as a silhouette against a rising sun, the ground around him untouched by footprints, a crowd of camp dwellers gathered at a distance watching, cold blue mist on the sand

scenes.title: الإحصاء
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: three clerks in clean pale grey robes sitting at a long wooden table in the open air with thick ledgers and ink pots, writing as families queue before them, children separated into a second queue by a rope, grey overcast light, tents behind, the atmosphere orderly and wrong

scenes.title: أم سلمى
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: an older woman in a black headscarf sitting perfectly still on a wooden stool outside a tent, hands folded, face completely calm and empty, a young bearded man kneeling in front of her talking, the empty stool beside her, grey light, laundry line behind

scenes.title: البوصلة
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: a brass compass held in a man's scarred hands, close up, the needle pointing away from north toward the right edge of frame, a blurry pale-robed figure standing far in the background in that direction, dusty ground, golden hour light

scenes.title: الخيمة الفارغة
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: the interior of a huge empty tent, completely bare, a single oil lamp on the ground in the precise centre, canvas walls with no furniture, no carpets, no people, a young bearded man standing at the entrance silhouetted against the daylight, dust suspended in the air

scenes.title: التوزيع
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: a cheerful open-air distribution line at a camp, people receiving bread and medicine with smiles, men in pale robes handing out sacks, and to one side a clerk marking names in a ledger with a red cord tying the pages, grey sky, warm lanterns

scenes.title: الصوت المسروق
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: a lean bearded man speaking into a small shortwave radio at night, and behind him on tall poles loudspeakers boom across the camp, his words coming back from a hundred directions, tents lit by lanterns, a crowd listening, oppressive scale

scenes.title: الصوت
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still: a tall figure in a long pale robe standing face to face with a lean bearded man at the edge of a camp at night, the tall figure's face completely lost in a soft glow, one hand raised gently, the young man's radio held between them like an offering

scenes.title: الاسم التاني
scenes.prompt_ar: Wide 16:9 cinematic film still at dawn: a young bearded man walking away from a vast tent camp toward an empty grey desert, a small radio in one hand, and on the canvas door of the nearest tent a name written in charcoal, the camp behind him silent and still, long shadow ahead of him
